news.titleEn: Payrolls surge past forecasts in August, raising Fed rate-hike odds
news.conclusionEn: U.S. employers added 162,000 jobs in August, far more than the 53,000 expected, while unemployment held at 4.1%, pushing the market-implied odds of a Fed rate hike this month to about 58%.
news.conclusionZh: 8月非农新增16.2万人远超预期，加息概率升至58%
news.whyEn: The upside surprise complicates the Fed's Sept. 15-16 decision, sending Treasury yields higher and stocks lower, and could keep borrowing costs elevated for mortgages and businesses worldwide.
news.whyZh: 意外强劲数据令美联储决策复杂化，推高美债收益率，冲击全球股市和借贷成本
news.detailEn: The August gain was the strongest since March, led by hiring at bars and restaurants, while information-sector jobs declined, partly reflecting AI-driven efficiency gains. Average hourly earnings rose 0.3% for the month and 3.1% over the past year, keeping wage growth firm. The report followed comments from Fed Governor Christopher Waller earlier in the week suggesting he could support holding rates steady, but the strong data pushed traders to raise September hike odds from about 52% to 58%. The Dow fell 271.86 points (0.51%) to 53,414.25, the S&P 500 slid 0.38% and the Nasdaq dropped 0.29%, while the 2-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since January 2025. Attention now turns to next week's inflation data as the final input before the Fed's meeting.
news.detailZh: 8月新增就业为3月以来最强，酒吧餐饮业带动招聘，而信息行业岗位减少，部分反映AI带来的效率提升。平均时薪环比涨0.3%，同比涨3.1%，工资增长依然强劲。此前美联储理事沃勒本周曾暗示可能支持维持利率不变，但强劲的就业数据令交易员将9月加息概率从约52%上调至58%。道指跌271.86点（0.51%）至53414.25点，标普500跌0.38%，纳指跌0.29%，两年期美债收益率触及2025年1月以来最高。市场焦点转向下周通胀数据，这将是美联储9月会议前最后的关键参考。

news.titleEn: Brent oil tops $96 a barrel after Iran fires missiles at Kuwait
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude climbed above $96 a barrel and WTI neared $91 this week after Iran fired missiles at Kuwait, with oil up roughly 8% as U.S.-Iran strikes renew fears over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗向科威特发射导弹，布伦特原油站上96美元
news.whyEn: About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes through Hormuz, so a sustained risk premium feeds directly into global inflation, fuel costs and central-bank policy decisions.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡占全球海运石油约五分之一，油价溢价推高全球通胀与利率压力
news.detailEn: The U.S. carried out fresh strikes against Iran this week after roughly a month of relative calm, and Tehran retaliated by targeting American bases and vessels passing through Hormuz. Despite the fighting, more than 17 million barrels of oil transited the strait on Monday under U.S. military escort, a wartime record, though still below the roughly 20 million barrels a day seen before the war began. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the escorted convoys show the U.S. can keep oil flowing despite the conflict, but analysts expect prices to stay elevated as long as tankers remain exposed to attack. The spike is a key driver behind this week's jump in Treasury yields and renewed inflation concerns weighing on the Fed's rate decision.
news.detailZh: 美国本周对伊朗发起新一轮打击，此前双方已相对平静约一个月，德黑兰随后以打击美军基地和通行霍尔木兹海峡的船只作为报复。尽管冲突持续，周一仍有超1700万桶原油在美军护航下通过海峡，创战时纪录，但仍低于开战前约每日2000万桶的水平。美国能源部长赖特表示，护航船队证明即便冲突持续，美国仍能维持石油供应，但分析师预计，只要油轮仍面临袭击风险，油价就会维持高位。此轮油价飙升是本周美债收益率上升和通胀担忧重燃的主因之一，正对美联储的利率决策构成压力。

news.titleEn: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute, threatens oil firms with sanctions
news.conclusionEn: Argentine President Javier Milei revived his country's claim to the Falkland Islands and vowed tougher sanctions on companies drilling for oil near the British-controlled territory, targeting the Sea Lion project developed by Rockhopper and Navitas.
news.conclusionZh: 阿根廷总统米莱重提马岛主权，威胁制裁附近石油公司
news.whyEn: The move deepens a sovereignty dispute with Britain and rattled shares of the companies involved, coming as Trump has cast doubt on U.S. support for Britain over the islands.
news.whyZh: 争端加深英阿矛盾，相关公司股价下跌，特朗普对英美同盟立场存疑
news.detailEn: In a televised address, Milei said the islands were Argentina's 'historically and legally' and that its residents did not have the right to self-determination. His plan calls for a law change allowing sanctions to extend beyond the two oil firms to their suppliers, shareholders and directors, with violators potentially barred from operating in Argentina altogether. The sanctions target the Sea Lion deep-sea oil field, about 140 miles north of the islands, being developed by Britain's Rockhopper Exploration and Israel's Navitas Petroleum. Shares of Rockhopper fell about 6% and Navitas about 2% in early trading after the announcement, adding a new flashpoint to UK-Argentina relations more than four decades after the 1982 Falklands War.
news.detailZh: 米莱在电视讲话中表示，马尔维纳斯群岛「从历史和法律上」都属于阿根廷，岛上居民不享有自决权。其计划拟修法，将制裁范围从两家石油公司扩大至其供应商、股东和董事，违规者可能被完全禁止在阿根廷开展业务。制裁目标是位于岛屿以北约140英里处的「海狮」深海油田，由英国洛克霍珀勘探公司和以色列纳维塔斯石油公司共同开发。消息公布后，洛克霍珀股价早盘跌约6%，纳维塔斯跌约2%，为1982年马岛战争四十多年后的英阿关系再添新变数。

news.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, declares 'the AGI era'
news.conclusionEn: OpenAI began rolling out its new flagship model, GPT-6 Astra, to select partners on Sept. 3, with co-founder Greg Brockman declaring 'welcome to the AGI era' as the company touted top scores on reasoning benchmarks.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Astra，宣称已进入「AGI时代」
news.whyEn: The launch intensifies competition among AI labs and raises the bar for rivals, while its advanced computer-use and coding abilities could accelerate automation across white-collar work.
news.whyZh: 新模型加剧AI实验室竞争，其自动化能力或加速白领工作变革
news.detailEn: GPT-6 Astra is rolling out first to a limited set of organizations and will expand over coming days to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, as well as through OpenAI's API and AWS. OpenAI says the model is state of the art in cybersecurity, computer use, software engineering and scientific reasoning, capable of navigating browsers, spreadsheets and desktop applications to complete multistep tasks much like a human worker. The company claims near-perfect scores on key reasoning benchmarks, surpassing its own GPT-5.6 Sol and rival models. Pricing on the standard API is set at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, roughly 2.5 times the current promotional rate for GPT-5.6 Sol.
news.detailZh: GPT-6 Astra首先向少数机构开放，未来数天将扩展至ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise用户，并通过OpenAI API及亚马逊AWS提供。OpenAI称该模型在网络安全、计算机操作、软件工程和科学推理方面处于业界领先水平，能像人一样操作浏览器、表格和桌面应用完成多步骤任务。公司称其在关键推理基准测试中取得接近满分的成绩，超越自家GPT-5.6 Sol及竞争对手模型。标准API定价为每百万输入token 10美元、每百万输出token 50美元，约为GPT-5.6 Sol现行优惠价格的2.5倍。

news.titleEn: AI data center builder Crusoe raises over $3 billion at $30 billion valuation
news.conclusionEn: Crusoe, a cloud-computing and AI data center developer, closed a funding round of more than $3 billion at roughly a $30 billion valuation, nearly tripling the valuation it set less than a year ago.
news.conclusionZh: AI数据中心公司Crusoe融资超30亿美元，估值达300亿
news.whyEn: The deal underscores investors' continued appetite for AI infrastructure even as some worry about overbuilding, and reflects surging demand for the power-hungry data centers that run AI models.
news.whyZh: 交易显示投资者对AI基础设施热情不减，反映数据中心需求持续飙升
news.detailEn: The round was co-led by Atreides Management and Valor Equity Partners, with Mubadala Capital also participating. Crusoe's new valuation nearly triples the more than $10 billion mark it reached in October 2025. The company builds and operates data centers for clients including OpenAI, Microsoft and Meta, with a flagship 1.2-gigawatt cluster under construction for OpenAI in Abilene, Texas. Bloomberg also reported that Crusoe recently signed a $13 billion, five-year cloud contract to supply trading firm Jane Street with GPUs and AI infrastructure, highlighting how deeply AI compute demand now extends beyond the biggest tech companies.
news.detailZh: 本轮融资由Atreides Management和Valor Equity Partners共同领投，穆巴达拉资本也参与其中。Crusoe此次估值较2025年10月约100亿美元的估值几乎翻了两番。该公司为OpenAI、微软和Meta等客户建设并运营数据中心，其中为OpenAI在得州阿比林建设的旗舰项目装机容量达1.2吉瓦。彭博社还报道，Crusoe近期与交易公司Jane Street签订了一份为期五年、价值130亿美元的云服务合同，提供GPU和AI基础设施，显示AI算力需求已深入蔓延至科技巨头之外的行业。

news.titleEn: Feds launch investigation into Tesla's Cybercab deployment
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an audit into Tesla's Cybercab robotaxi almost immediately after its Sept. 3 commercial launch in Austin, questioning how Tesla certified a vehicle with no steering wheel, pedals or mirrors.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉无方向盘Cybercab刚上线即遭美国联邦调查
news.whyEn: The probe could slow the rollout of Tesla's driverless robotaxi business, a key pillar of its future growth story, and sets a regulatory precedent for other autonomous-vehicle makers.
news.whyZh: 调查或拖慢特斯拉无人车业务扩张，并为自动驾驶行业树立监管先例
news.detailEn: Tesla told NHTSA the Cybercab meets 'all applicable' federal safety standards, but the agency wants to examine the technical basis for that claim, including which standards Tesla determined don't apply to a vehicle with no manual controls. NHTSA is using the same audit process it applied to Amazon-owned Zoox, which received a formal exemption from eight federal vehicle-safety standards earlier this year. Separately, videos have surfaced showing Tesla's robotaxis driving on the wrong side of the road and braking erratically during the Austin pilot, prompting additional scrutiny. The outcome could determine how quickly Tesla can scale Cybercab beyond its initial limited service.
news.detailZh: 特斯拉向美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）表示，Cybercab符合所有适用的联邦安全标准，但该机构希望审查这一说法的技术依据，包括特斯拉认定哪些标准不适用于这款没有人工操控装置的车辆。NHTSA采用了此前审查亚马逊旗下Zoox的同一流程，Zoox今年早些时候已获得八项联邦车辆安全标准的正式豁免。此外，有视频显示特斯拉的无人出租车在奥斯汀试运营期间出现逆行和急刹车等异常情况，引发更多关注。调查结果将决定特斯拉能否将Cybercab从目前的有限服务范围加快扩张。

news.titleEn: Germany's far-right AfD eyes election breakthrough as it surges in Saxony-Anhalt
news.conclusionEn: Polls show the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading with around 41% support ahead of Saxony-Anhalt's state election on Sept. 6, far ahead of the CDU at about 23%, raising the prospect of Germany's first far-right state governor since World War II.
news.conclusionZh: 民调显示极右翼AfD在萨克森-安哈尔特州大幅领先
news.whyEn: A win would mark a historic breakthrough for Germany's far right and could reshape national politics, unsettling investors watching European political stability.
news.whyZh: 若获胜将是德国极右翼历史性突破，或重塑全国政局及欧洲政治预期
news.detailEn: According to the Forschungsgruppe Wahlen poll, the AfD leads with 41%, followed by the CDU at 23%, the Left party at 11.5%, the SPD at 8.5% and the Greens at 6%. Even with a commanding lead, the AfD is unlikely to govern alone, since other parties clearing the 5% threshold could combine to deny it an outright majority. Germany's mainstream parties have so far maintained a 'firewall' refusing to form coalitions with the AfD, which is classified in parts as right-wing extremist by domestic intelligence. A strong AfD showing would still mark its best regional result yet and add pressure on Chancellor Friedrich Merz's coalition nationally.
news.detailZh: 据Forschungsgruppe Wahlen民调，AfD以41%的支持率领先，基民盟（CDU）以约23%排名第二，左翼党11.5%，社民党8.5%，绿党6%。即便大幅领先，AfD也难以单独组阁，因其他跨过5%门槛的政党联合起来仍可能阻止其获得绝对多数。德国主流政党迄今维持「防火墙」策略，拒绝与被部分认定为极右翼的AfD组阁。即便如此，如此高的支持率仍将是AfD迄今最佳的地方选举成绩，并会为联邦总理默茨的执政联盟带来更大压力。

news.titleEn: Rescuers pull two trapped workers from a hydropower tunnel nine days after Nepal floods
news.conclusionEn: Rescuers in Nepal pulled two hydropower workers out alive on Sept. 4, nine days after a glacial and rock collapse near the China-Nepal border unleashed floods that killed more than 1,300 people and left thousands missing.
news.conclusionZh: 尼泊尔洪灾九天后，两名被困工人从水电隧道生还获救
news.whyEn: The rescue offers rare hope amid one of the region's deadliest disasters this year, with hundreds of workers still missing and search efforts continuing at multiple hydropower sites.
news.whyZh: 灾区仍有数百人失踪，此次生还给持续搜救带来罕见希望
news.detailEn: The two survivors, a mechanical foreman and a mechanical supervisor, were found in the Trishuli 3A tunnel after rescuers heard a faint response from inside. They had survived in the dark for over a week; one said he prayed throughout the ordeal. The Aug. 26 disaster, triggered by a glacial and mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border, killed at least 1,325 people and left more than 5,500 missing, with roughly 900 hydropower workers unaccounted for across about a dozen project sites. International rescue experts, including from Australia, are assisting Nepalese teams as searches continue at Trishuli 3A and other flood-hit tunnels.
news.detailZh: 两名幸存者分别是一名机械工班长和一名机械主管，救援人员在Trishuli 3A隧道内听到微弱回应后将其寻获。两人在黑暗中被困逾一周，其中一人称自己靠祈祷撑过了整个过程。8月26日，中尼边境一处冰川和山体崩塌引发洪灾，造成至少1325人死亡、5500多人失踪，约十几个水电项目工地中仍有约900名工人下落不明。包括澳大利亚专家在内的国际救援队正协助尼泊尔团队，在Trishuli 3A及其他受灾隧道继续搜救。

businessTips.explanationEn: Parkinson's Law states that work expands to fill the time available for its completion — give a task a week and it takes a week, even if it could be done in a day. First coined by historian C. Northcote Parkinson in 1955, it explains why deadlines, not available time, are often the real driver of productivity. The practical lesson for managers and teams is that loosely bounded time invites scope creep, procrastination and unnecessary polish, while tighter, well-chosen deadlines force focus on what actually matters. It's a useful diagnostic whenever a project seems to be taking far longer than its complexity would suggest.
businessTips.explanationZh: 帕金森定律指出，工作会自动膨胀以填满可用的完成时间——给一项任务一周时间，它就会用满一周，哪怕一天就能做完。这一说法由历史学家诺斯古德·帕金森于1955年提出，解释了为什么真正驱动效率的往往是截止日期，而非可用时间本身。对管理者和团队而言，实用的启示是：模糊、宽松的时间安排容易滋生范围蔓延、拖延和不必要的过度打磨，而更紧凑、精心设定的截止日期则能迫使团队聚焦真正重要的事。当一个项目耗时远超其本身复杂度时，这条定律是很好的诊断工具。
businessTips.exampleEn: A marketing team is given a full month to prepare a routine quarterly report, and true to the law, drafts, revisions and meetings stretch to fill nearly the entire month. The next quarter, the manager sets a hard five-day deadline for the same report instead. The team cuts unnecessary polish, skips a redundant review round, and delivers a report of comparable quality in a fraction of the time.
businessTips.exampleZh: 某营销团队被给予整整一个月准备一份常规季度报告，果然如定律所言，草稿、修改和会议几乎填满了整个月。到了下一季度，经理为同样的报告设定了五天的硬性截止日期。团队砍掉了不必要的打磨、跳过了一轮多余的审核，最终以远少的时间交出了质量相当的报告。

businessTips.explanationEn: A fake door test validates demand for a product before it's built by presenting a landing page, ad or button for something that doesn't exist yet, then measuring how many people click, sign up or try to buy it. If enough people show real intent — an email address, a pre-order, a click on 'Buy Now' — that's evidence worth building the thing; if almost no one engages, you've saved months of development on an idea nobody wanted. It's one of the cheapest ways for a solo founder or side-hustler to test an idea against reality before investing real time or money.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「假门测试」是在产品做出来之前，先用一个落地页、广告或按钮展示一个尚不存在的功能或产品，然后统计有多少人点击、注册或尝试购买，以此验证市场需求。如果足够多的人表现出真实意愿——留下邮箱、预订、点击「立即购买」——就说明这个想法值得动手做；如果几乎无人理会，你就用极低成本避免了把数月开发时间投入一个没人想要的点子。这是独立创业者或副业经营者在投入真金白银之前，用现实检验想法最便宜的方式之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before building a new premium feature, a small SaaS founder adds a 'Team Collaboration (Pro)' button to the existing app that, when clicked, only shows a message asking users to join a waitlist. Within two weeks, 40 out of 2,000 active users click and sign up, giving the founder a rough conversion signal that justifies spending the next month actually building the feature.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在着手开发一项新的高级功能前，一位小型SaaS创业者先在现有应用里加了一个「团队协作（专业版）」按钮，点击后只会弹出提示，邀请用户加入等候名单。两周内，2000名活跃用户中有40人点击并注册，这个初步的转化信号让创始人认为，接下来花一个月真正开发这项功能是值得的。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration risk is the sensitivity of a bond's price to changes in interest rates — the longer a bond's duration, the more its price falls when rates rise, and the more it gains when rates fall. A bond with a duration of 10 years will lose roughly 10% of its value for every 1-percentage-point rise in interest rates, while a bond with a duration of 2 years will lose only about 2%. This matters because investors often assume 'safe' government or investment-grade bonds can't lose money, but long-duration bonds can suffer sharp price declines even without any default risk, purely because rates moved against them.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「久期风险」指债券价格对利率变化的敏感程度——债券久期越长，利率上升时价格跌得越多，利率下降时涨得也越多。久期为10年的债券，利率每上升1个百分点，价格大致会下跌约10%；而久期为2年的债券，跌幅只有约2%。这一点很重要，因为投资者常常误以为「安全」的政府债券或投资级债券不会亏钱，但长久期债券即便完全没有违约风险，也可能仅因利率走势不利而出现大幅价格下跌。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor buys a 20-year government bond fund because it's labeled 'low risk,' then watches its price drop nearly 15% over several months as central banks raise rates to fight inflation, even though no bond in the fund actually defaulted. Someone who instead held a short-term bond fund with a duration of two years saw only a small dip, illustrating why duration — not just credit quality — determines how much a bond's price can swing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者因为「低风险」的标签买入一只20年期政府债券基金，结果在央行为抗通胀加息的几个月里，基金价格下跌近15%，而基金里没有一只债券真正违约。相比之下，另一位持有久期仅两年的短期债券基金的投资者，跌幅很小。这说明决定债券价格波动幅度的，往往是久期而非单纯的信用质量。
